simple.meaning: יְדָא (yᵉdâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to praise.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:23. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְדָא (H3029) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: יְדָא (yᵉdâʼ) / H3029 is traced through Daniel 2:23, Daniel 6:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.
